description: `handoff --to Priya` and `--to "Priya Raman"` fail with UNKNOWN_ACTOR and no hint. The agent must find a 70-character Actor ID (or UUID handle) elsewhere, and must hand-build the --revisions JSON from show output.
expected: --to resolves an unambiguous display name, or the error lists candidates ('Did you mean Priya Raman (actor-3eac…)? See pardner actors list').
suggested_fix: Resolve unique display names in --to; include close matches in UNKNOWN_ACTOR details and message.

description: A handoff to Priya is invisible as such at the places she looks first: the board card shows no 'handed to you' or unread badge, and in the panel the handoff message 'Done' renders as an ordinary comment.
expected: The card carries a 'New for you' badge, and the handoff comment is labelled 'Handed off to you · Review'.
actual: Only the generic New tag inside the panel; the board is silent.
suggested_fix: Mark handoff comments with a handoff caption; add an unread or mention badge on board cards.
